title: TSS_iEEG

funding_references.funder_name: National Institute Of Neurological Disorders and Stroke

description: This intracranial EEG (iEEG) dataset comprises recordings from 7 participants undergoing closed-loop theta-synchronized stimulation of hippocampal networks. The dataset includes pre- and post-stimulation evoked potentials, resting-state recordings, closed-loop stimulation sessions, and control stimulation periods. Data are organized according to BIDS iEEG specification with electrode coordinates registered to MNI152 2009c space, supporting investigations of hippocampal network connectivity modulation through real-time theta oscillation control.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG recordings were acquired from 7 participants during a closed-loop stimulation protocol. Data were segmented into multiple conditions: pre-stimulation and post-stimulation evoked potentials, pre-stimulation and post-stimulation rest periods, closed-loop stimulation sessions, and control stimulation. Raw data are stored in BrainVision format with electrode coordinates provided in MNI152 2009c asymmetrical template space.
